subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the reported generated-doc gap, and two open conflicting PRs attempt overlapping fixes with different proof and implementation signals.

options.title: Refresh the stronger proven sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable refreshing it on current main and rerunning proof.

options.title: Repair the same-author PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 if maintainers prefer the issue author's smaller branch after it resolves conflicts and satisfies review proof.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Pause or close both overlapping branches and ask for one narrow generator/check PR if neither current branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh the stronger proven sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable refreshing it on current main and rerunning proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent stabilization work on the same credential matrix docs surface makes steipete the best available routing owner for the implementation-path choice.
